period_note: Sourced from the Annual Report 2024's own 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials (Consolidated) by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table. *** BASIS MISMATCH: this table's data is genuinely CONSOLIDATED, NOT Solo, while this dataset's main Q4/annual series for FY2024 is Solo/Bank-Total *** (bank_financials/PREMIERBAN/quarterly/2024_Q4.json, from the Segment Reporting 'Bank Total' column: Total Assets 449,626.03m, Total Equity 27,042.86m, PAT 1,454.59m). PROOF: this table's Dec-31-2024 column (Total Property and Assets 449,984.38m, Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity 26,804.45m, Net Profit After Tax 1,341.61m, NAV 21.73) reproduces EXACTLY against the FY2024 report's own separate, full Consolidated Balance Sheet/Consolidated Profit and Loss Account (Total Assets 449,984,382,748; Profit after taxation 1,341,611,968) and against the FY2025 report's own comparative Consolidated column for FY2024 -- all of which diverge from the Solo/Bank-Total figures (this is the same year 2024_Q4.json documents the Solo entity being marginally profitable while subsidiary Premier Bank Securities Ltd posted a loss, pulling Consolidated PAT below Solo PAT). Q1/Q2/Q3 2024 figures below are therefore also Consolidated. VALIDATION FLAG (not an error, explained): cumulative Consolidated PAT DECREASES from Q3 (2,501.63m) to the full year (1,341.61m), implying a discrete Q4-alone Consolidated loss of approximately -1,160.02m -- consistent with the already-documented FY2024 asset-quality shock (full-year Total Provision of 6,333.76m vs only 2,901.29m cumulative through Q3, i.e. roughly 3,432m of provisioning recognised in Q4 alone; classified loans jumped 5.2x this year per 2024_Q4.json). No Solo-basis version of the Q1-Q3 2024 interim data was found anywhere else in the FY2024 or FY2025 report text. No independent same-period comparator table exists to cross-check for restatement (single-current-year-only table).
